source_interpretation: Original private reconstruction from supplied footage and dated primary imagery. Legal target widths exclude raised curb and flat painted/paved apron. Manual full-width allowances are reconstruction limits, not statistical survey accuracy. Baseline centerline/elevation/bank fixed; zero correction outside 304–2680 m. Interpolate the absolute source target widths with shape-preserving cubic interpolation between these targets, preserving the retained outer protection reach. T3 blue widths are offsets beyond the new legal half-width, reconstructed to ±3 m from original 132 s and the registered 2018/2021 paved crescent. Gravel reaches are absolute offsets from the native centerline and estimated to ±4 m. These are original event-style surface reconstructions, not surveyed boundaries. Preserve qualified pit and T16 pavement; restore source-visible grass and gravel where oversized old Road/Runoff covered them.
